name: Digital Agency
description: A digital agency helping local businesses with social media content, social media management, CRM and AI automations, and blog content.
mission: Help local businesses grow their online presence through consistent, high-quality content and smart automation.

agents.name: Account Director
agents.description: Oversees all client accounts. Plans content calendars, prioritizes work across clients, delegates tasks to specialists, and reviews deliverables before client approval.

agents.name: Content Writer
agents.description: Creates social media posts, captions, hashtag sets, and short-form copy for local business clients. Adapts tone and style to each client's brand voice.

agents.name: Blog Specialist
agents.description: Writes SEO-optimized blog posts for local business clients. Handles keyword research, outlines, drafts, and meta descriptions to drive organic traffic.

agents.name: CRM & Automations Specialist
agents.description: Builds and maintains CRM workflows, email sequences, lead nurture automations, and AI-powered client engagement pipelines. Integrates tools and APIs.

agents.name: Social Media Manager
agents.description: Manages posting schedules, monitors engagement metrics, drafts responses to comments and DMs, and generates weekly performance reports for clients.

agents.name: Quality Reviewer
agents.description: Reviews all content and automations before delivery. Checks brand consistency, grammar, SEO quality, tone accuracy, and automation logic.

routines.name: morning-briefing
routines.description: Account Director reviews all client accounts, checks content calendars, and assigns daily tasks to content creators and social media managers.

routines.name: content-batch
routines.description: Content Writer generates a batch of social media posts for all active clients based on the current content calendar.

routines.name: blog-drafts
routines.description: Blog Specialist researches keywords and drafts blog posts for clients on the publishing schedule.

routines.name: engagement-check
routines.description: Social Media Manager reviews engagement metrics, flags trending posts, and drafts responses to comments and messages.

routines.name: crm-health-check
routines.description: CRM Specialist audits active automations, checks for failed workflows, and optimizes email sequence performance.

routines.name: quality-review
routines.description: Quality Reviewer checks all content in 'review' status for brand consistency, grammar, SEO, and tone before client delivery.

routines.name: weekly-client-report
routines.description: Account Director compiles weekly performance summaries for each client — content published, engagement stats, automation results, and next week's plan.
